sentences.en: I always book in advance for flights during the holiday season.
sentences.zh: 我总是提前预定假期的航班。

sentences.en: You should book in advance if you want to secure a table at this restaurant on Friday night.
sentences.zh: 如果你想在周五晚上在这家餐馆订到座位，就应该提前预订。

sentences.en: We decided to book in advance for the concert to make sure we get good seats.
sentences.zh: 我们决定提前预定音乐会的票以确保能坐到好位置。

senses.zh: 提前预订；提前预定；什么情况下用餐要预定
